avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces saxagliptin plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use or monitor glycemic control closely if co-administration is unavoidable

avoid_supplements.name: Ginseng (American/Asian)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate hypoglycemic effects and increase risk of low blood glucose episodes
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use with caution; monitor blood glucose levels closely

caution_supplements.name: Turmeric (Curcumin)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 inhibition may slightly increase saxagliptin exposure; may enhance glucose-lowering effects
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for signs of hypoglycemia; no dose adjustment typically required

caution_supplements.name: Garlic Extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive hypoglycemic effects; may enhance saxagliptin's glucose-lowering action
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose; inform patient of additive effects

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit Juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase saxagliptin plasma concentrations; unlikely to require dose adjustment at therapeutic doses
caution_foods.action: Limit grapefruit consumption; monitor for adverse effects if frequent intake occurs

monitoring_notes: Saxagliptin has relatively low food interaction risk; however, CYP3A4 inhibitors/inducers may affect exposure. Monitor HbA1c, renal function, and signs of hypoglycemia, especially when adding supplements that alter glucose metabolism or CYP3A4 activity.
